stories.title: VIctory-NVIDIA — VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on…
stories.author: trustno1-coder
stories.snippet: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks. Built on many repos combined into one. No game files or NVIDIA files included.
